metaDescription: Asian Doula Alliance is a nonprofit standards body for postpartum doulas: its legal entity, board, conflict of interest rules, documents and contacts.
title: A nonprofit standards body for postpartum doulas
lead: Asian Doula Alliance writes the curriculum and the professional standard for postpartum doulas in Asian immigrant communities, examines candidates and keeps the public registry. It does not place doulas with families or provide care.

cta.title: Ask for ADA’s {form990}, bylaws or policies.
cta.subject: Document request

does.title: What ADA does
does.photoAlt: An instructor stands beside a wall screen showing a slide, teaching a session of the ADA Postpartum Doula Program
does.photoCaption: An instructor teaches the ADA Postpartum Doula Program. {date}.
does.does1: Publishes the standard and the Code of Conduct
does.does2: Writes the ADA curriculum and approves training programs
does.does3: Runs and grades the certification exam
does.does4: Keeps the public registry of ADA-certified doulas
does.doesNot1: Match families with doulas or provide care
does.link: Standards and the Code of Conduct

board.title: Board
board.intro: The board has {count} volunteer directors. Directors are not paid.
board.chosenValue: Elected by ADA’s certified doula community, for terms of {years} years.

independence.title: Independence and conflicts of interest
independence.body: Each director signs a conflict of interest disclosure every year. A director with a material interest in a decision does not vote on it, and a related-party transaction needs the affirmative vote of the independent directors.
independence.curriculumValue: ADA writes the curriculum and the professional standards.
independence.trainingValue: ADA-approved training programs teach the ADA curriculum.
independence.examValue: ADA runs and grades the certification exam itself: a {written}-minute written exam and a {practical}-minute one-on-one practical exam.
independence.registryValue: ADA keeps the public registry. Anyone can check a doula’s credential there, free and without an account.
